items.name: folder-tray
items.title: Folder Tray
items.description: Interactive 3D isometric tray of folders with custom solid colors and click-to-open actions. Inspired by and built on @lucasmarkes/hairline.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: Standalone forward-facing folder card with 84x61 vector geometry adapted from @lucasmarkes/hairline.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Tactile 3D push button engineered with physical extrusion depth and click kinematics.

items.name: select-bar
items.title: Select Bar
items.description: Elastic kinetic segmented pill and color swatch selector with two-phase mercury dilation and overshoot landing.

items.name: seek
items.title: Seek
items.description: Kinetic search icon that springs into a focused input with continuous physics, cursor magnetic pull, and tactile yield.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Interactive 3D isometric GitHub contribution heatmap with 14-week timeline, official dark, halloween, and winter themes, and tactile impulse shockwaves.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Organic liquid goo switch with two-blob chasing kinematics, pointer drag tracking, and SVG metaball necking.

items.name: label-input
items.title: Label Input
items.description: A field whose label is its placeholder until focused. Outline parts from middle outward with letter-by-letter hopping text.

items.name: label-textarea
items.title: Label Textarea
items.description: An auto-expanding multiline textarea with dynamic SVG border notch physics and letter-by-letter hopping label.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Fluid morphing copy button with animated content width measuring and popLayout icon/text transitions.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Equal-area crop switcher with constant 276-square bounding box, leading slider thumb, and 520ms morph transitions.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: Rolling odometer counter with forward-only column rolling, staggered carry ripples, velocity blur smear, and drag coasting physics.

items.name: wake-slider
items.title: Wake Slider
items.description: Thumbless range control with dynamic kinetic wave energy and velocity-sensitive exponential decay wake.

items.name: palette
items.title: Palette
items.description: Perceptual OKLCH harmonic color palette generator with 5 generative moods and liquid elastic overshoot morphing.

items.name: time-scrubber
items.title: Time Scrubber
items.description: Tactile time picker over a rolling ruler dial with inertia fling coasting, unified spring settling, and front-dial cylindrical tick projection.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: Harmonic spring task checklist with drawn checkmarks, strikethrough timing, and physical gravity collapse on completion.

items.name: create-menu
items.title: Create Menu
items.description: Fluid morphing create button that expands into a window with continuous kinematic physics, concentric nested row radii, and traveling liquid hover droplet highlights.

items.name: fluid-search
items.title: Fluid Search
items.description: Metaball search disclosure where the pill field and close circle fluidly separate on focus and seamlessly fuse back when closed.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: A tactile card pile that fans out radially along an eccentric virtual pivot on hover and fluidly draws cards into full-frame 3D view on press.
